node.title: L1 exact-shell complement Toeplitz normal form
node.statement: On a multiplicative-coset domain with locator Z^n-beta, let A have size a, w=a-k, and let M be the degree-(n-a) locator of its complement. The barycentric exact-shell moment sum_(x in A)U(x)x^j/L_A'(x) equals [Z^(n-j-1)]U(Z)M(Z). Hence deg I_A(U)<k iff UM has a length-w coefficient gap in degrees n-w through n-1. This fixed Toeplitz map is invariant under adding any degree-below-k codeword to U. Exact agreement shells are in bijection with monic complement divisors M of Z^n-beta in the Toeplitz zero section whose cofactor is coprime to M. The remaining global theorem is primitive Toeplitz split-divisor flatness or a paid transport to upstream prefix-affine divisor Q; no flatness is asserted here.
